action.old_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"), (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"), (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy ndarray")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be 2-dimensional")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.issubdtype(arr.dtype, np.floating):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} dtype must be floating point")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    # Check shapes match
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("shapes of the three matrices must match")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if tau_filter < 0 or not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite nonnegative")
    # Compute normalized weights
    future_horizon = shape[1]
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    # Compute weighted sums
    weighted_no_call = np.dot(logp_no_call, normalized_weights)
    weighted_call_only = np.dot(logp_call_only, normalized_weights)
    weighted_with_result = np.dot(logp_with_result, normalized_weights)
    # Compute margins and mask
    margins = np.maximum(weighted_no_call, weighted_call_only) - weighted_with_result
    keep_mask = margins > tau_filter
    return keep_mask, margins
